releaseNotes:
- Lunaverse Agent can now create a character's complete Series V2 portrait from a natural request, including automatic real-person casting, face development, look development, and final full-body delivery
- Production DAGs now keep a reviewable visual history with stage progress, casting thumbnails, intermediate images, and final selections
- Long-running production now surfaces actionable provider failures and recovery context, while flexible character interpretation avoids unnecessary stops on rigid Bible fields
- Story planning and episode workflows now use the current canonical adaptation Skills with safer concurrency and clearer review handoffs
releaseNotesZh:
- Lunaverse Agent 现可从一句自然语言请求完成角色的整套 Series V2 立绘，包括自动真人选角、面容开发、定妆与最终全身立绘交付
- 生产 DAG 现会保留可回看的图形化历史，展示阶段进度、选角缩略图、中间图片与最终选择
- 长流程生产现会展示可操作的供应商失败原因与恢复上下文，并以灵活的角色理解避免因固定 Bible 字段而不必要地中断
- 故事策划与分集工作流现采用最新统一改编 Skills，并提供更安全的并发执行和更清晰的审核交接
